observations.title: Looted ancient statue returned to Egypt
observations.page_title: Looted ancient statue returned to Egypt
observations.page_description: The director of Vienna's Art History Museum (KHM) Sabine Haag handed over on Monday a priceless Egyptian statue to the Egyptian ambassador after it was recovered from two suspected antiquity thieves earlier this year.
